name: Broadcast Hour
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Near-Earth Hub: Broadcast Center, System Update 2021's NBN identity, which draws a card the first time each turn it creates a remote server. On Pay to Win's frame, its identity swapped. Two Turtlebacks for its two Drago Ivanov, a Jinteki asset that gains a credit whenever a server is created; two Hostile Infrastructure for its two Chekist Scion, a Jinteki asset that does a net damage whenever the Runner trashes a Corp card, itself included. Ten influence of seventeen. Pay to Win keeps every card given up here. Tranche 8 Stage 4. Tranche 8 Stage 7b: two Tollbooth for its two Virtual Service Agent, a code gate for a code gate, whose 3[credit] the Runner must pay if able or the run ends; Paid Content, Grand Opening and Pay to Win keep Virtual Service Agent. FFG F1 Stage 4: two TGTBT for its two Oracle Thinktank, a 1-point agenda for a 1-point agenda, which tags the Runner who accesses it and is revealed in R&D; three decks keep Oracle Thinktank. FFG F1 Stage 5: two Bernice Mai for its two Sync Rerouting, an upgrade whose Trace[5] tags the Runner or trashes her; another deck keeps Sync Rerouting. FFG F2 Stage 5: two Fly on the Wall for its two Post-Truth Dividend, point for point, Arella Salvatore for its The Holo Man, an upgrade for an upgrade, and SIU for its Janaína "JK" Dumont Kindelán, an asset for an asset; other decks keep all three. Reign and Reverie Stage 14: two Eavesdrop for its two Ganked!; two other decks keep Ganked!. Kitara Stage 1: two Endless EULA for its two Tollbooth and two Sandman for its two Hydra; each is in another deck. Kitara Stage 3 took two Echo Chamber and two Calibration Testing for its Capacitors and Lethes. Kitara Stage 4b: two Better Citizen Program for two Freedom of Information, and TechnoCo for an F2P.
